aggregation_method: COUNT(*) WHERE active
notes: Snapshot from 2022 dump. For backtests ≤2021: use util_histo_establishment if available, else flag as not_safe.

aggregation_method: COUNT(*) WHERE status=active
notes: Same leakage concern as above. Active = not ceased per SIRENE.

aggregation_method: Shannon entropy of A10 distribution
notes: Diversity = -Σ p_i * log(p_i) over A10 sectors within ZE2020.

aggregation_method: HHI = Σ (share_i)^2 over A10 sectors
notes: HHI in [0
column9: 1]. High = concentrated economy. Complement to diversity.

aggregation_method: COUNT of establishments in modal NAF A10 sector
notes: Which sector dominates. Informative for recommendation layer.

aggregation_method: share = top_naf_count / n_establishments
notes: Share of dominant sector. Used for specialization profiling.

aggregation_method: weighted mean PCI
notes: Product complexity index (PCI) is static from Harvard Atlas. Low leakage risk if PCI source data pre-dates training period. Mark as observed_available for all years if PCI vintage ≤2018.

aggregation_method: weighted mean resilience score
notes: Static resilience score. Same leakage logic as PCI.

aggregation_method: weighted mean green score
notes: Green score source not confirmed. Use as post-model layer until source validated.

aggregation_method: join via city.industry_territory_id
notes: rank_economic_growth is at industry_territory level. Verify IT→ZE2020 compatibility. industry_territory ≠ ZE2020.

aggregation_method: sum of iot_potential scores per ZE2020
notes: Computed potential: uses IO table. Static snapshot. Do NOT use for backtest ≤2021 without temporal control. Safe as post-model interpretation layer.

aggregation_method: sum of partner_calc scores per ZE2020
notes: Same leakage risk as supplier_potential. Static 2022 snapshot.

source_table_iat: vw_naf_proximity JOIN establishment (A10 pairs within ZE2020)
aggregation_method: mean proximity score between co-present NAF sectors
notes: Mean within-ZE2020 NAF proximity: how diverse + complementary is local sector mix.

aggregation_method: COUNT(recommendations) per establishment / total_estab
notes: Density of active recommendations. Static 2022 snapshot. Use only as post-model layer.

aggregation_method: mean RCA>1 product count per establishment
notes: RCA computed from 2019 Douanes data. For training ≤2019: observed. For 2020–2021: lagged_available (use t-1). For 2022+: requires annual Douanes update.

aggregation_method: import/export ratio per ZE2020 (via department proxy)
notes: Department-level proxy (not ZE2020-native). Aggregation introduces measurement error. Document clearly.

aggregation_method: mean workforce per establishment within ZE2020
notes: Requires workforce_count column in establishment table. Confirm after DB restoration.

aggregation_method: mean IO coefficient for sector pairs present in ZE2020
notes: Derived from static IO table. Sectors present in ZE2020 × IO coefficients = structural supply chain exposure.

aggregation_method: density = mean proximity to products where RCA>1
notes: Harvard Atlas density metric: how close is ZE2020 to its next potential export product. Requires IT→ZE2020 mapping.

aggregation_method: mean green score of products where RCA>1
notes: Green transition readiness proxy. Post-model interpretation layer.

aggregation_method: share of basic need products in local production basket
notes: Territorial food/energy/health sovereignty proxy. Post-model layer.
